palindrome:
A palindrome is a word, phrase, number, or other sequence of characters which reads the same backward as forward. Here's an example of a 255-character palindrome:

"Able was I ere I saw Elba. A man, a plan, a canal: Panama. Able was I ere I saw Elba. A man, a plan, a canal: Panama. Able was I ere I saw Elba. A man, a plan, a canal: Panama. Able was I ere I saw Elba."

This palindrome repeats the famous pangram "Able was I ere I saw Elba. A man, a plan, a canal: Panama." six times. This structure ensures that it reads the same forwards and backwards while being at least 255 characters long.
